name: Shanying International Holdings Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanying International Holdings Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in papermaking, packaging, and renewable resource recycling businesses in China and internationally. The company constructs, operates, and manages renewable resources recycling network system. Its paper making business includes kraft liner, corrugated paper, coated kraft paper, white top liner, newsprint, bag paper, and cotton swab paper, as well as bleached hardwood pulp, UFS, and inkjet paper. The company also offers water-based, pre-printed, offset printing, and digital printing carton, as well as paper molding.
